name: onepipeline-packaging
//: The packaging proofs: the npm journeys that build, pack, install or publish the release artifacts, and the Docker-built Linux wheel. release.yml builds, test-installs and verifies every package before it publishes, so a pull request runs these only when it changes what the packages contain. `packagingSelection` and `input-selection` are the one list of what selects them; `scripts/nx-version-free-selection.mjs` drops this project when the only change it reads is a Cargo version or a justfile recipe the packages never run (the `selection:version-free` tag). `packagingHash` adds, as runtime inputs selection ignores, what else they read: the binary's sources, the versioned manifests and the recipes.

packagingHash.runtime: node .github/workspace-proof-input.mjs src crates schemas README.md LICENSE CHANGELOG.md
node scripts/nx-recipe-input.mjs wheel-linux release-linux release-linux-arm64 release-macos release-windows release-publish

build.//: Nothing to build ahead of the proofs: each builds the artifact it proves.

format.//: This project's sources are onepipeline-npm's and the release scripts, which their own projects format and lint.

test.//: The crate's debug build (`just _crate-build`) runs first, as its own task: the publish journey packs that build, and a suite that compiled it itself held the tree's lock past the publish journey's 900-second setup.

wheel-smoke.//: llmlint: ignore-block[external_service_suite_stays_out_of_the_affected_tier] the x86_64 Linux wheel, built by the release's own script in its manylinux image (Docker), installed into a venv and smoke-tested. It pulls that image and a toolchain, and runs on a pull request only when packagingSelection or input-selection selects this project, so the build a release would refuse is refused where it is cheapest to fix. Uncached, because what it proves is that the wheel installs on the host it runs on. After onepipeline:install-smoke, whose Linux run times the host-view-time budget's reads: the image pull and the container's release compile starve the 4-vCPU runner, and test-linux's run 41316119034 read 192 ms against its 100 ms when the pull overlapped them, where every other run read 17 to 70 ms.

input-selection.//: Selection-only manifest edges: Nx affected ignores runtime inputs. A version-only Cargo edit, and a justfile edit to no recipe packagingHash names, are dropped from this project's selection by scripts/nx-version-free-selection.mjs.
